tenderSchedule.description: Manpower Services by providing Office Attenders & Store Helpers through outsource agencies in the jurisdiction of Transmission Operations Zone, KPTCL, Bagalkote
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPTCL CEE Transmission Zone Office Bagalkot

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have provided manpower services in State/ Central Government Departments/ Organizations, Public sector / Private Companies / Banks and Financial Institutions, KPTCL / ESCOMs of contract value not less than Rs. 30.88 Lakhs per annum evidencing the same, satisfactorily (usually not less than 50% of the tender amount), to at least one reputed Organization for a minimum period of One year during the last three financial years. Documentary proof of the same in the form of work done certificate issued by competent officers (not below the rank of EE or equivalent cadre) are to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- work done certificate issued by competent officers (not below the rank of EE or equivalent cadre)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall be a reputed Manpower providing agency having valid registration certificate issued by Department of Labour / Directorate of Industries and Commerce, GOK for providing manpower services. Documentary proof in the form certificate of registration issued by GOK is to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- certificate of registration issued by GOK

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall comply with all the provisions under Karnataka Minimum Wages Act, Labour Laws such as EPF, ESI and Payment of Wages etc. and provide the necessary proof of its compliance every month together with the bill. In case the tenderer fails to provide such proof of payments made to the personnel in which month it is due and such default occurs for more than 3 months in any continuous period of 12 months, the same will be considered as Breach of Contract. The tenderer shall comply with all the statutory requirements evidencing the same.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self- declaration letter by the tenderer in the letterhead of the firm along with the ESI and EPF registration certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should be in a position to provide tendered number of man power service within one week from the date of award of Contract.
The tenderer should be registered under GST Act, proof of which should be submitted along with the Permanent Account Number (PAN) assigned by the Income Tax Department.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GST Certificate & Permanent Account Number (PAN) assigned by the Income Tax Department

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer whose contracts have been terminated/ foreclosed / blacklisted/ penalized by any Organizations during the last three years due to non-fulfillment of contractual obligations/deficiency in service are not eligible to participate in the tender

The tenderer shall upload the power of attorney in the prescribed format on Rs.500/- non-judicial stamp paper. Original power of attorney shall be sent in original to Chief Engineer Electy., Transmission (Operations) Zone, KPTCL, Bagalkote to reach after the last submission date & on or before the date & time of opening Techno commercial Bids.

The offer of the tenderers taking deviations in following clauses will be summarily rejected. 1. Tender Validity , 2. Earnest money deposit, 3. Payment, 4.Penalty, 5.Reporting Time, 6.Price Basis, 7.Tenderers past performance in rendering services.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self - declaration letter in writing in the letter head for No deviation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have achieved in at least two financial years (in the last Five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 61.76 Lakhs not less than the amount put to tender. Documentary proof certified by a Chartered Accountant is to be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Documentary proof certified by a Chartered Accountant
